SSQ Predictor — 双色球分析预测助手 v4.2.0

- 数据分析模型与数据源已更新至2026年6月，覆盖最新官方开奖数据。
- 新增量化技术动态、市场动态等板块，介绍2026年相关量化分析框架更新和技术基建进展。
- 方法论动态更新，补充MCP架构及回测任务能力说明。
- 内容结构优化，合并与精简部分声明和用法说明。
- 移除多余 skill-card.md 文件，文档更聚焦于主功能。
Version 4.1.1 - Minor update to address review feedback and improve security declarations

- Major update: Added 4 new analysis dimensions (质数/合数、尾数分布、重号/邻号/跳号、分区密度、号码间距、对称性等)，实现双色球号码选择18维综合分析
- 精简与重构说明文档，突出安全合规声明和用户意图确认，强调教育娱乐用途
- 完全移除执行脚本与数据采集说明，工具不再包含可执行/存储/联网功能
- 细化并统一分析方法解释、推荐区间与应用策略
- 删除 skill-card.md，文档结构更清晰

- Added major new 2026-version features: real-time jackpot integration, enhanced Monte Carlo simulation (up to 100,000 iterations, Bayesian updates), upgraded AI heatmap visualizations, and genetic algorithm-based intelligent bet reduction.
- Refreshed data to 2026-05-25; analysis model parameters updated for latest period.
- Updated skill description, keywords, and slug for improved clarity and discoverability.
- Added a “数据更新最新动态” (Latest Data Update) section detailing data update status and source.
- Documentation now highlights new 2026 analysis dimensions and workflow enhancements.

- Refreshed historical data analysis for more up-to-date insights.
- Improved Monte Carlo simulation for better number prediction.
- Added trend visualization (走势图) using plotly.
- Enhanced combination deduplication algorithm for optimized ticket generation.

- Initial release of chance-ssq-predictor (version 1.0.0)
- Provides analysis and number selection for China Welfare Lottery (双色球/SSQ), including missing value, frequency, sum value, span, odd-even, and more
- Integrates step-by-step workflow for user requests, data preparation, and number recommendation (3–5 sets with analysis)
- Includes sample commands and usage scenarios for different analysis and selection needs
- Offers detailed methodology and quick-start guidance; all features for entertainment use only
